description: This file implements the EntityDatatableChecksReadPlatformService interface, providing methods for retrieving and managing datasheets related to entity data table checks within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes functionality for fetching check configurations, templates, and filtered paginated results, utilizing JDBC for database interactions and integrating with domain services for loans and savings products.

classes.name: EntityDatatableChecksReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the EntityDatatableChecksReadService interface, providing core logic for fetching entity data table check configurations, templates, and filtered paginated lists, integrating with the database and related domain services.

classes.name: RegisterDataTableMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map database rows to DatatableChecksData objects.

classes.name: EntityDataTableChecksMapper
classes.description: Inner static class implementing RowMapper to map database rows to EntityDataTableChecksData objects, including schema generation for checks data.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of entity data table checks based on search parameters, status, entity, and product ID filters.

methods.name: retrieveTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves a list of datatable configurations/templates relevant to a given entity, status, and product ID.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Constructs and returns an aggregate template data object, including available data tables, statuses, entities, and related products.

methods.name: getStatusList
methods.description: Converts a list of StatusEnum into a list of DatatableCheckStatusData objects.

methods.name: getDataTables
methods.description: Fetches all registered data tables from the database.
